description: List incidents for a team — {incidents:[...], totalIncidents, totalOpenIncidents, pagination}. Each incident carries title, status, priority, severity, and timing. Spike: GET /incidents (team-scoped).

teamId.description: The 24-char hex team _id to scope this request to (x-team-id). Omit to use the configured default (SPIKE_TEAM_ID). List ids with spike_list_teams.
